title: Add the simplified collision asset generator and its throughput study
summary: A tool writes a variant of the approved USD with one primitive collider per link (19 shapes) in place of the 153 SDF meshes, with the same contact offsets; the approved asset is unchanged and the variant is gitignored. On the Spark the hexapod Direct task steps 2.4x faster at 128 robots and 4.5x at 2048. Over five repetitions, a policy trained on the SDF asset walks on the variant within 3% of its speed and without falls, but with about 1 degree more heading error and 2.6 times as many joints at the torque cap. The variant has no native admission, so new training on it is not permitted; it serves diagnostics.
next: Decide with the program lead whether the variant becomes a club asset with its own one-robot and batch standing admission; keep solver iterations at 32 until that check.
reason: The generated asset is an unadmitted throughput variant for the hexapod Direct task; the approved USD, omniwalk and every gate are unchanged.
